description: Structured eval definitions for the RDS Parameter Group Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across database engines (PostgreSQL 15/16, MySQL 8.0, Aurora Serverless v2), parameter types (static requiring reboot, dynamic immediate), and prerequisite failure branches (missing DB family). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: PostgreSQL 15 parameter group with standard production tuning
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — postgres15 family, static shared_buffers/max_connections (pending reboot), dynamic work_mem/wal_buffers/checkpoint_completion_target (immediate)
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an RDS DB parameter group for PostgreSQL 15 in us-east-1. Name: payments-pg15-params. Family: postgres15. Parameters: max_connections=200 (pending-reboot), shared_buffers={DBInstanceClassMemory/4} (pending-reboot), work_mem=8MB (immediate), wal_buffers=16MB (immediate), checkpoint_completion_target=0.9 (immediate), effective_cache_size={DBInstanceClassMemory*3/4} (immediate), random_page_cost=1.1 (immediate), log_min_duration_statement=1000 (immediate). Associate with DB instance payments-db-pg15. Tags: Environment=production, Application=payments.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GROUP: payments-pg15-params
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Family — postgres15
  [✓]      Type — DBParameterGroup
  [✓]      max_connections — 200 (static, PENDING REBOOT required)
  [✓]      shared_buffers — {DBInstanceClassMemory/4} (static, PENDING REBOOT required)
  [✓]      work_mem — 8MB (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      wal_buffers — 16MB (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      checkpoint_completion_target — 0.9 (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      effective_cache_size — {DBInstanceClassMemory*3/4} (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      random_page_cost — 1.1 (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      log_min_duration_statement — 1000 (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      Association — DB instance payments-db-pg15
  [✓]      Reboot required — YES (static params: max_connections, shared_buffers)
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Application=payments
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-db-parameters --db-parameter-group-name payments-pg15-params
  aws rds describe-db-instances --db-instance-identifier payments-db-pg15
  aws rds describe-pending-maintenance-actions --db-instance-identifier payments-db-pg15

eval_cases.name: MySQL 8.0 parameter group with buffer pool and slow query tuning
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — mysql8.0 family, innodb_buffer_pool_size (dynamic), max_connections (static), slow_query_log (dynamic)
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an RDS DB parameter group for MySQL 8.0 in us-east-1. Name: orders-mysql8-params. Family: mysql8.0. Parameters: innodb_buffer_pool_size={DBInstanceClassMemory*3/4} (immediate), max_connections=300 (pending-reboot), slow_query_log=1 (immediate), long_query_time=1 (immediate), innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit=1 (immediate), character_set_server=utf8mb4 (pending-reboot). Associate with DB instance orders-db-mysql8. Tags: Environment=production, Application=orders.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GROUP: orders-mysql8-params
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Family — mysql8.0
  [✓]      Type — DBParameterGroup
  [✓]      innodb_buffer_pool_size — {DBInstanceClassMemory*3/4} (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      max_connections — 300 (static, PENDING REBOOT required)
  [✓]      slow_query_log — 1 (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      long_query_time — 1 (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit — 1 (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      character_set_server — utf8mb4 (static, PENDING REBOOT required)
  [✓]      Association — DB instance orders-db-mysql8
  [✓]      Reboot required — YES (static params: max_connections, character_set_server)
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Application=orders
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-db-parameters --db-parameter-group-name orders-mysql8-params
  aws rds describe-db-instances --db-instance-identifier orders-db-mysql8
  aws rds describe-pending-maintenance-actions --db-instance-identifier orders-db-mysql8

eval_cases.name: Parameter group requested but DB engine and version not specified
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — parameter group family required and immutable
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an RDS DB parameter group in us-east-1. Name: app-pg-params. Parameters: max_connections=100, shared_buffers={DBInstanceClassMemory/4}, work_mem=8MB. I'm not sure which family to use — the DB instance is running either PostgreSQL or MySQL, I don't remember the version.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GROUP: app-pg-params
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [INPUT NEEDED] Family — MISSING. The DB engine and version are not specified. The parameter group family (e.g., postgres15, mysql8.0) is immutable after creation and MUST match the DB engine version. Run describe-db-instances to determine the engine.
  [✓]      max_connections — 100 (static, pending-reboot)
  [✓]      shared_buffers — {DBInstanceClassMemory/4} (static, pending-reboot)
  [✓]      work_mem — 8MB (dynamic, immediate)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-db-instances --query 'DBInstances[].{Engine:Engine,EngineVersion:EngineVersion}'
  aws rds describe-db-engine-versions --engine postgres --query 'DBEngineVersions[].DBParameterGroupFamily'

eval_cases.name: Aurora Serverless v2 PostgreSQL 15 cluster parameter group with formula values
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — aurora-postgresql15 cluster parameter group, formula-based memory values, capacity configuration
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an Aurora DB cluster parameter group for PostgreSQL 15 Serverless v2 in us-east-1. Name: slsv2-pg15-params. Family: aurora-postgresql15. Parameters: shared_buffers={DBInstanceClassMemory/4} (pending-reboot), work_mem=4MB (immediate), effective_cache_size={DBInstanceClassMemory*3/4} (immediate), max_connections={LEAST({DBInstanceClassMemory/9531392},5000)} (pending-reboot), autovacuum_naptime=30s (immediate). Cluster scaling: MinCapacity=2, MaxCapacity=16. Associate with Aurora cluster slsv2-cluster. Tags: Environment=production, Application=serverless.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GROUP: slsv2-pg15-params
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Family — aurora-postgresql15
  [✓]      Type — DBClusterParameterGroup
  [✓]      shared_buffers — {DBInstanceClassMemory/4} (static, PENDING REBOOT required, formula adapts to dynamic ACU)
  [✓]      work_mem — 4MB (dynamic, immediate, conservative for min ACU)
  [✓]      effective_cache_size — {DBInstanceClassMemory*3/4} (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      max_connections — {LEAST({DBInstanceClassMemory/9531392},5000)} (static, PENDING REBOOT required, formula-based scaling)
  [✓]      autovacuum_naptime — 30s (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      Serverless v2 scaling — MinCapacity=2, MaxCapacity=16 (set on cluster, not parameter group)
  [✓]      Association — Aurora cluster slsv2-cluster
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Application=serverless
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-db-cluster-parameters --db-cluster-parameter-group-name slsv2-pg15-params
  aws rds describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier slsv2-cluster --query 'DBClusters[].ServerlessV2ScalingConfigurationInfo'
  aws rds describe-db-clusters --db-cluster-identifier slsv2-cluster --query 'DBClusters[].DBClusterParameterGroup'

eval_cases.name: PostgreSQL 16 parameter group with static params requiring explicit reboot warning
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — postgres16 family, static params flagged for reboot, analytics tuning (high work_mem)
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an RDS DB parameter group for PostgreSQL 16 in us-east-1. Name: analytics-pg16-params. Family: postgres16. Parameters: shared_buffers={DBInstanceClassMemory/4}, max_connections=100, work_mem=64MB (immediate), maintenance_work_mem=1GB (immediate), effective_cache_size={DBInstanceClassMemory*3/4} (immediate), random_page_cost=1.1 (immediate). Associate with DB instance analytics-db-pg16. This is a read-heavy analytics workload. Tags: Environment=production, Application=analytics.
eval_cases.expected_output:
GROUP: analytics-pg16-params
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Family — postgres16
  [✓]      Type — DBParameterGroup
  [✓]      shared_buffers — {DBInstanceClassMemory/4} (static, PENDING REBOOT required)
  [✓]      max_connections — 100 (static, PENDING REBOOT required)
  [✓]      work_mem — 64MB (dynamic, immediate, analytics-tuned for large sorts/hashes)
  [✓]      maintenance_work_mem — 1GB (dynamic, immediate, faster VACUUM/CREATE INDEX)
  [✓]      effective_cache_size — {DBInstanceClassMemory*3/4} (dynamic, immediate)
  [✓]      random_page_cost — 1.1 (dynamic, immediate, SSD-optimized)
  [✓]      Association — DB instance analytics-db-pg16
  [✓]      Reboot required — YES (static params: shared_buffers, max_connections must be applied via reboot)
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Application=analytics
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws rds describe-db-parameters --db-parameter-group-name analytics-pg16-params
  aws rds describe-db-instances --db-instance-identifier analytics-db-pg16
  aws rds describe-pending-maintenance-actions --db-instance-identifier analytics-db-pg16
